notes.title: Into the Dark 2.0 - Final Update released!
notes.notes:
Every journey comes to an end...

...and today, almost ten years after the first concept of "Into the Dark" was envisioned, we present you the FINAL UPDATE to Into the Dark.

After updating Father`s Island to DirectX 11 and PBR

https://store.steampowered.com/app/460940/Fathers_Island/

we looked into Into the Dark again and did what was possible:


 Re-rendered all video cutscenes with better sound quality
 Improved the surface shading
 Added a post-credits scene
 Fixed the specularity artifacts
 Replaced the ugliest textures with 3D scanned surfaces
 Fixed all known sound bugs on weapons
 Reduced memory consumption by 20-25% and crashes by 60-80%
 Added additional fail-safes against script crashes
 Reconfigured the entire post processing pipeline


Important: Please uninstall and re-install, instead of updating, to have all changes take place!

Still, keep in mind that this is a game that was first released in 2012, based on a shooter construction kit that was in its core technology from 2003. So basically, we have 15 years old tech trying to look cool.

It is a little bit sad to say farewell to our most successful "own IP game", to the title that got us both harsh criticism, a Jim Sterling rant in full beauty - and several game of the year and other awards.

However, all hands on deck now for the sequel, "Into the Ice", which is heavily delayed, but still progressing. As a matter of fact, you get a little bit mroe of that now. We wanted to include a full playable slice, but severe AI problems did let us down. We included an AI test, in which you can now try to fight against two different AI moduels we are testing right now. let us know which one was harder to beat!

And here the content list for this final edition:


 Full "Into the Dark" game
 Including full lenght "Night of the Living Dead" in the ingame cinema
 Halloween Asylum level from 2015
 Into Ice Level 3 Work in progress from 2017
 Into the Ice AI test level from November 2018
 Savegame before outro in last slot
 Savegame before cutscene 1, one slot before the last one


Keep playing!

We will see each other again in....

https://store.steampowered.com/app/608610/Into_the_Ice_Nazis_of_Neuschwabenland/

So long! :NaziUfoLeft: :NaziUfoLeft: :NaziUfoLeft:

notes.title: Save on our games & the final patch is coming!
notes.notes:
:commie:Dear friends & followers, beloved haters and worshipped trolls, the time has come!:commie:

As you might know (or not), we released our next game on Steam, two years after this Ultimate Trash Edition here. It's called "Father's Island", plays i the same expanded universe as Into the Dark and is kinda the bridge between our trashy masterpiece *coughcough* and the sequel "Into the Ice" - despite being something different, gameplay-wise. And we get really GREAT feedback from gamers and press alike:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/460940

To celebrate that, we have decided to lower Into the Dark permanently to $7.99!

And to help you save even more, we created the ULTIMATE CONSPIRACY PACK, allowing you to get a discount of 23% (haha, do you get it?!) on each game of the series. This means, if you are new to the party, you get BOTH games for a whopping $9.99!

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/869/


That's the cheapest ticket to insanity you will ever get!

But here comes the part of todays extensive announcement that makes us both proud and a little bit sad:

Some of you have already noticed the latest screenshots and asked on Facebook or via email what the fuzz is about - and yes, it is time to confirm it:

We are working on the final patch for Into the Dark!

As promised, Into the Dark gets a major overhaul in the next few weeks. We have collected a total of 208 wishes, change requests and bug reports from you since the last update, and we intend to tackle most of them.

Here is what we can already promise:

:NaziUfoLeft: Increased stability on all systems
:NaziUfoLeft: Rock-solid Windows 10 compatibility
:NaziUfoLeft: All previous halloween bonus games included
(and yes, we will make new ones in the future, too)
:NaziUfoLeft: All audio and video files remastered
:NaziUfoLeft: Tweaked Textures & Shaders
:NaziUfoLeft: 12 new easter eggs and jokes


Here is what we really want to add:

:NaziUfoRight: PBR-based texture maps for all levels
(right now a test set is present in the first level, the wood wall)
:NaziUfoRight: New soundtracks for some levels
:NaziUfoRight: Tweaked weapons behaviour
:NaziUfoRight: Mitigation of the "damage on loading" bug
:NaziUfoRight: Fixing of ALL load / save issues and crashes upon dying


Here is what we are fooling around with, not sure if reasonable:

:jawright: AAA shader effects
:jawright: AAA light effects
:jawright: Dynamic Difficulty Level

However, this is also kind of a farewell for us. Not because we abandon support (we would never do that), but because of the fact that this polishing, the asset improvements and the tweaking will take little bit away from the special "Punk as Hell" attitude of the game.

Into the Dark has won us 4 Game of the Year awards, including the "Gamestar Game of the Year 2014 Community Favorite", and around 30 other awards and recommendations. It has brought furious hate-reviews and tremendous praise, V.I.P. invitiations to B-Movie festivals across Europe and actual death threats.
We have been subject to federal investigations because of something we show in this game that shouldn't be available to the public (Don't worry, all went calm and fine, and it's still in there), we have been interviewed by film makers and investigative journalists - hell, we even became targets of certain "political movements".

All that happened because of this game in its rough, ugly, unpolished, "f*** you"-attitude-showing state. Sure, we have patched before!
We fixed major issues, we improved some things we believed we could do better, we swapped posters, added new jokes - but it was still the same game.

And while we will keep all the content there in the final patch, a little bit of this fairy dust will be gone when the sound files don't kill your headphones and the textures won't make your eyes bleed anymore. 

So, you should really make one last run through Into the Dark as it is today, before the patch comes.

Which will be roughly by end of July.

All the best and love from Austria / Romania / Russia / USA,

Ivan from Homegrown Games :commie:

PS: We promised we would never remove the iconic clipping errors. Rest assured, we won't do that.
PPS: We won't fix my accent, too.

notes.title: Good news everyone, we are ordered to deliver this update to the planet of eternal doom!
notes.notes:
Hello friends, fans, followers and all those addicted to the smell of bad taste and gory trashiness, we are happy to announce that Into the Dark has won its 5th Game of the Year award yesterday as "Community Favorite 2014" in the German Gamestar magazine:

http://www.gamestar.de/specials/spiele/3084061/gamestars_2014_p3.html#community-liebling-2014

Celebrating that, we will put out another free content update over the Easter holidays, and we let YOU decide what to include:

( ) An improved version of the Halloween Bonus Game "Into the Woods"

( ) Another shot at the Steam trading cards, even if that means removing cameltoes and boobies on the card designs.

( ) A totally insane new 1-level-bonusgame fresh from our new engine.

( ) All of the above, even if that mean we get sleep-deprivation and even more insane!

Post your answer here ;)

notes.title: Patch 1.31a - now including an option menu!
notes.notes:
For almost two years the lack of an options / settings menu was one of the key USPs of "Into the Dark" - and obviously one of the most outrageous on-features for many players out there. Now we say good-bye to our own arrogance regarding the demands of players who want to set their own keys, invert the mouse or do blasphemous things like making the game brighter (Hey, it´s called Into the Dark for a reason!).

Patchnotes v 1.31a:

- Added an extremely ugly launcher that allows the following custom settings:

* GFX quality (3 settings: abysmal - bad - bearable)
* resolution (from 1024x768 to 1920x1200)
* Brightness (3 settings: Into the Dark - Out of the Dark - Into the Light)
* Adjustable amount of boobs
* custom keybinds / controls
* invert mouse y
* invert mouse x

- Changed 83 references "press ENTER" to "press USE KEY"
- 3 new easter eggs
- 2 new newspaper articles
- 1 new very offensive joke

- Slight texturing / GFX improvements
- 25% more performance (FPS) on GFX settings high (berable) when played with GFX cards like Radeon 68XX or better
- 12% more performance (FPS) on GFX settings medium (bad) when played on low-end GFX cards
- 3-6% less memory consumption
- 25-40% less crashes due to memory overflow
- 80% less crashes when played on GFX settings medium (bad)
- Improved underwater shader
- Improved ragdolling on Zombie Hookers

Enjoy the trash!

notes.title: Halloween Update - Celebrating 20.000 Steam players!
notes.notes:
Hi all!


First of all, we start with the bad news:

The "real" patch, including the option menu with custom keymapping, is STILL in development. Although it already looks pretty good that everything will work as requested by our community, I will have more work and testing on that, the estimated release date for the patch (including also several memory optimization and crashbug fixes)

IS SUNDAY, THE 9th OF NOVEMBER 2014!

A minor tweak for the main game has been applied today. As we can´t ensure your savegames won´t be overwritten, please back up them unless you dont want top start a new game (what we encourage you to do after the final patch anyways).

And as we now that you already have shown a huge load of patience, and as we know that we are asking for a little bit more, we want you to have a reward for your patience, enthusiasm and loyality.

Therefore the team members who are NOT working on the Patch or on the Into the Ice Prototype, have created a free Halloween Game for you - called

"Into the Woods".

Some screens are already in the store page:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/266050/ss_c0c28b1e130c5c3419f0194049c30c152121e983.jpg?t=1414733386

Let´s just say you are playing a nightmare Pete has some day between Into the Dark ends and Into the Ice begins.

Attention:

This is a free game made with an early beta version of "FPSC Reloaded". It takes a quite sophisticated machine to run well, but it has configurable graphics settings.
AI and mechanics are very basic, and there might be bugs all over the place - but as an Into the Dark player, that should not be new to you.

WE CANNOT GUARANTEE ANYTHING ON THAT.

No boobs and easter eggs yet, but if you like the game, we might continue updating it.

We wish you good luck on finding your way out of the forest ;).

PS: Hit "F" for the flashlight if it´s too dark for you!


And as we are celebrating the 20000th steam player joining the Into the Dark madness, we give away 20 keys for free.

First come - first serve. Grab & Run!

notes.title: Achievement Changes
notes.notes:
Dear players, 

we have followed the discussion and the controversial opinions regarding the "From Poland with Love" achievement closely. We understand that there are people from Poland who reported it as "hate speech", while many Polish players wrote (and some posted in our forums) it shall remain in the game, and that it made them laugh.

First of all, if someone really and honestly feels hurt and offended, I apologize.
Honestly.
And because we want to make people laugh and not cry, I decided to remove / change it.
Second, please keep in mind that EVERY SINGLE LINE that targets a specific minority is the idea from and has been written by a member of this minority / community. 
Yes, the one who had the idea for this joke some of you complained about, is actually a regular citizen of Poland. I contacted him early morning to tell him about the complaints and about my decision to have the achievement removed. He now asked me to post a personal note he has written on that, and I feel I owe him that. As those who complained owe him to read it:
______________________________________________________

Hello.
My name is Wiktor. I am a 38 years old IT specialist from Poznań, where I live with my wife and my children. I am working at a company IT department in Berlin, Germany.
I dont play many video games and I have never made my own game. I found the Into the Dark development project at very early stage when taking a look at mobile application software from TGC and offered my help.
I gave some textures and I did help optimize the health script and the collection script for the hentai pictures. I was surprised when Ivan offered me to implement an own achievement if I bring the idea because my work was really no big deal. It was my chance to be immortalized in a game, at this time I couldn’t risk being in credits because of complicated contract with my company.
I thought during a weekend and came up with the “thief” idea called “From Poland with Love!” 
Why?
Because the parts I made for the game came “From Poland with Love”. 
And because the thief and the stealing is an ongoing running gag I often hear here in Germany. We all know it’s a stereotype. We all know its also some little bit truth inside from the late 80ies and early 90ies. Sometimes it can be offending, but so can we.
We all laugh or grin when French people are drawn with ridiculous hat and moustache and giant baguette. 
We nod and smirk when Russians in cartoon drink Vodka and ride bear into battle. (By the way, polish Vodka is better!).
We still depict Germans with Prussian spiked helmets 100 years after World War 1. We laugh about their habit of always complaining and occupying beach chairs with towels when on holidays. Its also a stereotype. AND its funny.
Sometimes, when colleagues at work miss their purse, cell phone or watch, someone jokingly says “ask Wiktor”. I am NOT offended then, I get it’s a joke and nothing more.
When Homegrown made their so-called “sanity check” before they released the game, they asked me once again if people wont find it “too offensive”. I honestly answered no. I believed in the sense of humor of my compatriots. I did not think anyone would be hurt. 
Sad to see I was wrong.
Right now I feel kinda betrayed and backstabbed by my own people.
Homegrown Game promised me that I will have the chance to include something else in coming updates or their next game. So I guess all will be fine in the end.
Enjoy the game!

Greetings from Berlin,
Wiktor



______________________________________________________________

Again, we apologize to all of those who were really offended and / or hurt by this achievement. We already received several suggestions for a replacement, right now we switched it to something most of us can agree on ;)
However, good ideas are always welcome, the crazier, the better.

Best regards

Ivan Ertlov

Homegrown Games
